budget.metric: relative error of the simulated steady thrust (axial) force during full-diameter drilling
budget.note: The thrust is dominated by the chisel edge (extrusion at near-zero speed and strongly negative rake), which cutting-force models describe less well than the lips. Luo et al. quote Ucun's 80-90 % agreement for drilling simulations, i.e. 10-20 % deviation; their own tuned FE model reached 3.25 %. 20 % keeps a margin for the poorly specified drill geometry of the available references.
